Strong, increasing confidence in tens of billions of dollars of annual Data Center AI revenue in 2027, exceeding the >80% long-term CAGR target

ANTHROPIC COMMITS TO UP TO 2 GIGAWATTS OF MI450: AMD disclosed an agreement for Anthropic 'to deploy UP TO 2 GIGAWATTS OF MI450 SERIES GPUs IN AMD HELIOS RACKS', together with a MULTIYEAR COLLABORATION to optimise AMD Instinct GPUs and ROCm software development USING CLAUDE. This is the largest named MI450/Helios commitment to date and converts the 'additional multi-gigawatt opportunities' flagged last quarter into a specific customer and scale. CEO Lisa Su framed the second half around it: 'we enter the second half with strong momentum as EPYC demand accelerates, INSTINCT DEPLOYMENTS SCALE AND HELIOS BEGINS TO RAMP.' New silicon named in the quarter: MI455X, bringing leadership compute, memory capacity and bandwidth for large-scale AI training and inference, and MI430X, positioned as the most advanced accelerator for HPC and SOVEREIGN AI workloads.
quarterly_data.figure: Anthropic to deploy UP TO 2 GW of MI450 in Helios racks + multiyear ROCm collaboration using Claude

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 record results: revenue $11.5B, UP 50% year over year, with GAAP gross margin 54% (non-GAAP 56%), GAAP operating income $2.0B (non-GAAP $3.1B), GAAP net income $2.3B (non-GAAP $2.8B) and GAAP diluted EPS $1.38 (non-GAAP $1.66). DATA CENTER SEGMENT REVENUE $6.7 BILLION, UP 107% YEAR OVER YEAR — more than doubling on EPYC processors and Instinct GPUs — and now 58% OF TOTAL COMPANY REVENUE. Client and Gaming $3.8B (+6%; Client $3.1B +23% on Ryzen, Gaming $779M -31% on lower semi-custom); Embedded $977M (+19%). Q3 2026 GUIDANCE: revenue approximately $13 BILLION +/- $300M, representing roughly +41% year over year and +13% sequentially, with non-GAAP gross margin around 56%. CFO Jean Hu: 'We expect DATA CENTER SALES TO ACCELERATE IN THE SECOND HALF of 2026, driving stronger overall revenue growth and continued earnings expansion.' (Prior-year comparisons are flattered by $800M of inventory and related charges taken in Q2 2025 on the US export control covering Instinct MI308.)
quarterly_data.figure: Record rev $11.5B (+50%); Data Center $6.7B (+107%) = 58% of revenue; Q3 guide ~$13B (+41% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: CALL — 2027 GUIDANCE AND TAM RAISE: AMD now expects DATA CENTER SEGMENT REVENUE TO MORE THAN DOUBLE year over year in 2027 ('well over 100%', driven by data-center AI itself growing 'well over 100%'), with server CPU revenue up MORE THAN 70% off a much higher base and H2 2026 server revenue up more than 80% YoY. TAM raised barely six months after the last update: data-center AI accelerator market now seen growing >45% annually to ~$1.4 TRILLION by 2030, server CPU market >50% annually to ~$220 BILLION by 2030, and the overall high-performance/AI compute market ~40% annually, APPROACHING $2 TRILLION by 2030 — with AMD expecting to grow ABOVE the market. Helios monetisation: revenue per gigawatt is 'double-digit billions.' AMD is 'tracking materially ahead' of its Financial Analyst Day model: revenue growth to be substantially above the prior >35% target and the $20 annual EPS target to be SIGNIFICANTLY EXCEEDED within the strategic timeframe. On C.J. Muse's ~$30B 2027 Instinct estimate, Lisa Su: 'your data center AI number is probably too low.'
quarterly_data.figure: 2027: DC segment >2x, DC-AI 'well over 100%', server +>70%; TAMs: $1.4T accel / $220B server CPU / ~$2T total by 2030; $/GW = double-digit $B

quarterly_data.signal: CALL — HELIOS RAMP AND ECONOMICS: Helios is IN PRODUCTION with initial shipments beginning later in Q3, a step-up in Q4, a FURTHER step-up in Q1 2027, and a ramp through 2027; customer pull is 'very strong and TRACKING AHEAD OF OUR INITIAL FORECASTS' (a volume statement, per Lisa Su). Across inferencing workloads Helios delivers UP TO 15% MORE THROUGHPUT AT THE SAME RACK POWER and UP TO 30% MORE TOKENS PER DOLLAR than the competition, and carries ~50% more HBM than competing racks. Yields on the highly complex product are expected to improve over the next few quarters. Beyond the gigawatt-scale anchors (OpenAI, Meta, Anthropic — consuming via multiple CSPs), 'lots of customers' are interested at more regular scale, with good customer diversity expected by Q4/Q1. New Cerebras partnership: Helios plus Cerebras' Wafer Scale Engine forms a disaggregated FAST-INFERENCE solution available in Q4 in the Cerebras Cloud, extending into 2027. Supply: 'we have supply to more than meet the guidance... and the upside potential is there'; no data-center readiness constraint (land/power/shell) that threatens targets, though the range depends on how fast operators bring capacity online.
quarterly_data.figure: Helios: production now, ships late Q3 -> Q4 step-up -> Q1'27 step-up; +15% throughput/same power, +30% tokens/$; pull ahead of forecast

quarterly_data.signal: CALL — ROADMAP AND SOFTWARE: AMD will launch a NEW RACK-SCALE AI PLATFORM EVERY YEAR. The 2027 platform combines MI500 SERIES GPUs, VERONA CPUs and Pensando networking with EXPANDED SCALE-UP DOMAINS and BOTH COPPER AND OPTICAL-BASED INTERCONNECTS; MI500 is expected to deliver 'the LARGEST GENERATIONAL LEAP IN INSTINCT HISTORY,' putting AMD on track to increase inferencing performance MORE THAN 2,000x IN FOUR YEARS; multiple customers are already planning next-gen infrastructure on it. Software: ROCm 'has reached an important inflection point' — more than 3 MILLION MODELS run out of the box, leading open models launch with day-zero Instinct support, and open-source ROCm contributions are up MORE THAN 10x in a year. New ROCm.AI platform lets developers use Claude, Codex and Cursor coding agents to create, port and optimise Instinct code, delivering >2x training and >3x inferencing performance vs ROCm 7; AMD co-optimises ROCm with OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta.
quarterly_data.figure: Annual rack-scale cadence; 2027 = MI500 + Verona + Pensando, copper AND optical interconnects, >2,000x inference in 4 yrs; ROCm.AI >2x/>3x vs ROCm 7
